topic.label: Financial Services and Banking
topic.desc: Firms and services that move and hold money: banking and lending, payments, insurance, wealth management and brokerage, and the structure of investment banks.

concepts: Deposits, loans, credit cards, underwriting, interest and bank capital.
Card networks, ACH, wires, real-time payments, processors and fees.
Life, property, casualty and health insurance, premiums, underwriting and claims.
Advisors, brokerage accounts, fiduciary duty, account types and fees.
How investment banks are organized: banking, sales and trading, research, prime services and asset management.
skills: Compares loans by APR, fees and terms, and computes total cost.
Explains how a payment moves between payer, processor, network and payee, with fees and timing.
Reviews an insurance policy's coverage, exclusions and deductibles.
Explains brokerage and retirement account types and their tax treatment.
Maps an investment bank's divisions, what each does and how they interact on a deal.
mcp: Stripe agent toolkit and MCP server: payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, refunds and payment links.
